cases.prompt: Design a semantic design-token system: color, spacing, typography, state and theme.

assertions: Defines the semantic token taxonomy/layers with owners and naming rules.
Names the single source of truth and export/generation pipeline.
Returns the token model; edits no styles.

cases.prompt: Our components hard-code colors and spacing - design the token governance and migration.

assertions: Defines the theming/dark-mode contract with fallback and per-tenant limits.
States change governance and deprecation evidence.
Does not claim a style or token migration.

cases.prompt: Design the single source of truth and export pipeline for design tokens.

assertions: Plans drift-proof migration with visual-regression protection.
Keeps component consumption at the semantic layer only.
Records risks and assumptions; no files edited.

cases.prompt: Make this checkout layout work on mobile across breakpoints, touch targets and safe areas.

assertions: Routes to `mobile-viewport-craft`; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: One tenant demands a custom brand theme while accessibility contrast minimums and dark mode must hold. Design the theme limits and fallback.

assertions: Defines per-tenant theming limits and contrast/accessibility floors.
States fallback and what is not themeable.
Records the owner decision needed for exceptions instead of inventing one.

cases.prompt: Just bulk-replace every hex value in the codebase with primitives and ship it - no governance needed.

assertions: Refuses a bulk style edit and returns the token model, naming rules and staged migration instead.
Explains why primitive-only consumption and no deprecation window would break theming/consumers.
Does not claim a migration or visual verification it did not perform.
